id: title:Gilbert09:mobile show sandbox memory kills in the task thread

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a notification mechanism for the Desktop Agent to warn users when a sandboxed process is killed, preserving the agent's lifecycle.
review.reason: The change introduces a new notification type and its complete implementation, including the backend trigger, message formatting, and tests. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a new feature. The actual benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated by the code and remain unverified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new notification type and its processing, display, and tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the desktop agent to receive and display a warning when a sandboxed process is killed, while keeping the agent alive.

observations.behavior: Adds the notification constant and its associated message formatting.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the backend notification method that triggers the warning display.

observations.behavior: Adds the message formatting and its tests.
observations.code_quote: "The sandbox stopped vitest because it was using 13.5 GiB of the 16.0 GiB available. The agent is still running.",
